provider_object.source_status: Two local copies identical; bounded ELF socket/connect behavior corroborated. Not an exact producing-source/toolchain/log proof.

findings.claim: Whole-run zero IPv6 / only one socket is false. Whole raw has 124 socket records (74 domain10) and 101 connect records (52 family10). Only post-baseline has one domain2 socket/connect.

Trace is conditional on env plus immediate return-address DSO basename. Candidate run config selects libsscronet.so only. No trace does not prove no interposed call, especially for player/mffmpeg callers.

socket/connect preserve requested domain/address and delegate through a lazily resolved real function. No AF_INET6 rejection or numerical call-count log limit in these functions. Missing real symbol returns -1/ENOSYS before trace.

Resolver uses dlopen(libc.so, NOLOAD), then /system/lib64/libc.so NOLOAD, dlsym on handle, else RTLD_NEXT. This is a libc interposer, not a raw-syscall implementation. Exact target pointer/provider is not captured for r8 media.
findings.binary_check: Exact CAS full disassembly has no svc instruction or syscall PLT reference.

findings.claim: getaddrinfo invokes libc and conditionally converts musl addrinfo pointer order to Bionic only for selected callers; family is copied unchanged. Result trace prints at most16 nodes; this is not a socket-call limit. Non-selected caller receives unconverted libc results.
findings.boundary: Whether the media path calls this function and requires this translation is UNKNOWN; not a diagnosed ABI bug.

findings.claim: Other trace omissions are intentional: epoll_wait/poll omit zero-result/zero-saved-errno cases; epoll event detail max8 per call. No global numerical trace cap found in this493-line source.
SO_ERROR0 only reports the sampled fd socket error status. No media URL/fd linkage, TLS completion, stream bytes or decode established. IPv6 UDP connect success is also not remote reachability.

Hexadecimal values in mirrored <object,file,function,line> and [tcp @ object] are not thread IDs. The draft different-threads assertion lacks TID evidence. Error-line ordering still cannot establish a single causal chain.

minimum_next_static_work: Inspect exact libttmplayer/libmffmpeg network.c ff_listen_connect2 call/errno conversion sites and referenced socket/connect/getaddrinfo symbols/versioning; do not identify a provider from maps alone.

Separate immediate caller selection and returned addrinfo layout from socket family failure. Before claiming this is a libc or interposer failure, establish actual call target or an already-retained binding receipt.
No additional logging deployment is justified by the draft zero-domain premise; existing full raw and source already disprove it.
not_claimed: Media IPv4 or IPv6 end-to-end connectivity
System IPv6 routing support from UDP connect alone
privacy: URL/IP/token remain private; excerpt address fields redacted; references bind original file SHA and line numbers.
